name: get_screen
description: Retrieves the details of a specific screen within a project.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the screen to retrieve. Format: `projects/{project}/screens/{screen}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931/screens/98b50e2ddc9943efb387052637738f61`

projectId.description: Required. The project ID of screen to retrieve. Example: `4044680601076201931`, without the `projects/` prefix.

screenId.description: Required. The screen ID of screen to retrieve. Example: `98b50e2ddc9943efb387052637738f61`, without the `screens/` prefix.
